course_title: 英语底层规则、核心搭配与基础语法 30 组

groups.group_title: 主干先行：先说核心动作，再补细节
groups.learning_goal: 能先说清“谁做了什么”，再把时间、地点、原因等细节放到后面，说出自然的中文对应英文。

example_sentence.english: I met an old friend at the station.
example_sentence.chinese: 我在车站遇到了一位老朋友。

example_sentence.english: She is waiting at the station.
I saw him yesterday.
We stayed at home because it was raining.
example_sentence.chinese: 因为下雨，我们待在家里。

example_sentence.english: We had coffee together.
She got up early this morning.
He drinks coffee every morning.

vocabulary.memory_association: coffee 是英语中的音译外来词，中文“咖啡”与它发音相近。

example_sentence.english: She is busy today.

target.chinese: 主干先行：先说核心动作，再补时间地点原因
target.rule: 中文常把时间、地点、原因放在前面；英文更常见的顺序是先说“谁做了什么”，再把时间、地点、原因等细节放到后面。
target.when_to_use: 描述一件事、汇报发生了什么时，先让对方听到主干。
target.structure: 主语 + 谓语 + 宾语 + 地点 + 时间
target.correct_example_en: I met an old friend at the station yesterday.
target.common_mistake_en: Yesterday at the station I an old friend met.
target.correction: 改为 I met an old friend at the station yesterday. 英文先把主语和谓语说出来，地点和时间放后面，句子才自然。
required_material: 主语和谓语的基本概念
地点表达 at the station

accepted_answers_en: I met an old friend at the station yesterday.
Yesterday I met an old friend at the station.

sentences_to_memorize.prompt_zh: 我们昨天在车站一起喝了咖啡。
accepted_answers_en: We drank coffee together at the station yesterday.

accepted_answers_en: I meet my friend at the station every day.

transfer_cases.prompt_zh: 她昨天没来，因为她很忙。
accepted_answers_en: She didn't come yesterday because she was very busy.
She did not come yesterday because she was very busy.
Let's meet early tomorrow.
Let us meet early tomorrow.

transfer_cases.prompt_zh: 他们昨天一起去了车站。
accepted_answers_en: They went to the station together yesterday.
I drink coffee in the morning.
He gets up early every day.

transfer_cases.prompt_zh: 我昨天在车站见到了她。
accepted_answers_en: I met her at the station yesterday.

transfer_cases.prompt_zh: 我们明天一起喝咖啡吧。
accepted_answers_en: Let's drink coffee together tomorrow.
She is very busy today.

transfer_cases.prompt_zh: 他因为很忙，昨天没喝咖啡。
accepted_answers_en: He didn't drink coffee yesterday because he was very busy.

groups.group_title: 谓语唯一：一个简单句只有一个核心谓语
groups.learning_goal: 能判断一个简单句里只能有一个核心谓语，说出不含两个动词原形的正确句子。

example_sentence.english: I study English every day.
He works in a big city.
They live in this city.
She teaches English at a school.
The students study every day.
This city is very big.
I read English every day.
She speaks English well.

target.chinese: 谓语唯一：一个简单句只能有一个核心谓语
target.rule: 一个简单句只能有一个真正的谓语动词。想说第二个动作，可以把它变成 to do 或 doing，或者另起一句。
target.when_to_use: 句子里同时出现两个动作时。
target.structure: 主语 + 一个谓语 + 其他成分
target.correct_example_en: I study English every day.
target.common_mistake_en: I study English every day go to school.
target.correction: 改为 I study English every day. I go to school every day. 一个简单句只能有一个核心谓语，第二个动作要另起一句或改成非谓语。
required_material: 主语和谓语的基本概念
to do 与 doing 的基本概念

accepted_answers_en: I study English every day.
She teaches English at a school.
He lives in this city.
The students study hard every day.
He works in this city.
I read English every day.
She teaches students English.
This city is very big.
I live with my friends.
The students live in this city.
I work hard every day.
She teaches two students every day.

groups.group_title: 小弟伪装：第二个动作用 to do 或 doing
groups.learning_goal: 能在句子里出现第二个动作时，用 to do 或 doing 让它降级，不再把两个动词原形并排。

example_sentence.english: I want to learn English.

word_root.formation_note: 来自拉丁语 decidere，de-（离开）+ cidere（切），原意是切掉其他可能，引申为决定。

example_sentence.english: He decided to go home early.
I hope to see you soon.
She plans to travel next year.
I want to learn English.
I want to try this.

word_forms.chinese: 旅行（过去式/过去分词，英式拼写）
旅行（过去式/过去分词，美式拼写）
旅行（现在分词，英式拼写）

example_sentence.english: She plans to travel next year.

vocabulary.review_note: 英式 travelled/travelling 与美式 traveled/traveling 拼写不同，请核对课程要采用哪一套拼写。

example_sentence.english: It began to rain.

target.chinese: 小弟伪装：第二个动作降级成 to do 或 doing
target.rule: 一个简单句只能有一个核心谓语。第二个动作要降级：表示目的、打算、决定、希望时常用 to do；表示正在、经历或放在介词后时常用 doing。
target.when_to_use: 一句话里出现两个动作时。
target.structure: 谓语动词 + to do / 谓语动词 + doing
target.correct_example_en: I want to learn English.
target.common_mistake_en: I want learn English.
target.correction: 改为 I want to learn English. want 后面接动作要用 to do，不能把两个动词原形并排。

accepted_answers_en: I want to learn English.
He decided to go home early.
I hope to see you soon.
She plans to travel next year.
I want to try this.
The class begins at eight.
She decided to start today.
We hope to leave early.
I want to learn to swim.
They plan to travel together.
He tried to get up early.
It began to rain.

groups.group_title: 介词是胶水：动词和名词之间要搭桥
groups.learning_goal: 能记住 listen to、look at、wait for、arrive at、talk about、think about、depend on 这些固定说法，不再把动词直接硬接名词。

example_sentence.english: Listen to me, please.
Please look at the blackboard.
I am waiting for the bus.
We arrived at the station at eight.
They are talking about the movie.
example_sentence.chinese: 他们正在谈论那部电影。

example_sentence.english: I am thinking about my plan.

word_root.formation_note: 来自拉丁语 dependere，de-（向下）+ pendere（悬挂），原意是悬挂在……之下，引申为依赖。

example_sentence.english: It depends on you.

target.chinese: 介词是胶水：动词和名词之间要搭桥
target.rule: 很多动词不能直接接名词或代词，需要介词来搭桥，例如 listen to、look at、wait for、arrive at、talk about、think about、depend on。
target.when_to_use: 表达听、看、等、到达、谈论、考虑、依赖等常见说法时。
target.structure: 动词 + 介词 + 名词/代词
target.correct_example_en: I am waiting for the bus.
target.common_mistake_en: I am waiting the bus.
target.correction: 改为 I am waiting for the bus. wait 表示等待时后面要跟介词 for。
required_material: 动词与介词的固定搭配

accepted_answers_en: I am waiting for the bus.
Please look at the blackboard.
Listen to me.
We arrived at the station at eight.

transfer_cases.prompt_zh: 他们正在谈论那部电影。
accepted_answers_en: They are talking about the movie.
I am thinking about my plan.
It depends on you.
She is waiting for me.
Look at this map.
Please listen to this song.

transfer_cases.prompt_zh: 我们在谈论明天的计划。
accepted_answers_en: We are talking about the plan for tomorrow.
I arrived at the school.

groups.group_title: 介词后必穿马甲：介词后面的动词要加 -ing
groups.learning_goal: 能在 before、after、without、instead of、of 等介词后面把动词变成 -ing 形式。

example_sentence.english: Wash your hands before dinner.
We went home after the class.
He left without saying goodbye.
I drink tea instead of coffee.
She is afraid of dogs.
I am tired of waiting.

target.chinese: 介词后面动词必须加 -ing
target.rule: 介词（before、after、without、instead of、of 等）后面的动词要变成 -ing 形式，因为这时动作已经具有名词性质。
target.when_to_use: 介词后面出现动作时。
target.structure: 介词 + doing
target.correct_example_en: Wash your hands before eating.
target.common_mistake_en: Wash your hands before eat.
target.correction: 改为 Wash your hands before eating. before 是介词，后面的动词要加 -ing。
required_material: 动名词 doing 的形式

accepted_answers_en: Wash your hands before eating.
Wash your hands before you eat.
He left without saying anything.

transfer_cases.prompt_zh: 下课后我们去喝了咖啡。
accepted_answers_en: We drank coffee after class.
I run before breakfast every day.
She ran without drinking water.
I drink tea instead of coffee.
He is afraid of swimming.
I am tired of waiting for the bus.

transfer_cases.prompt_zh: 吃完饭以后，我们散了一会儿步。
accepted_answers_en: We took a walk after eating.
You should think before answering.
She went out without eating breakfast.

transfer_cases.prompt_zh: 他喜欢听音乐而不是看电视。
accepted_answers_en: He likes listening to music instead of watching TV.

groups.group_title: 时间靠变形：英文用动词变形表达时间
groups.learning_goal: 能根据时间词把动词改成正确的时态形式，而不是靠加“了”“昨天”“正在”。

example_sentence.english: I watched a movie last night.
She has already finished.
He has just left.
She is doing her homework now.
I usually get up at six.
We will meet tomorrow.
He left two days ago.
I watched a movie last night.

target.chinese: 时间靠动词变形，不靠加时间副词
target.rule: 英文的过去、现在、将来、正在，主要靠动词本身变形或加助动词表达。时间词只是补充说明，不能代替动词变形。
target.when_to_use: 说明动作发生在过去、现在还是将来时。
target.structure: 一般现在时用原形或加 s；一般过去时加 -ed 或用不规则形式；进行时用 be + doing；将来用 will 或 be going to
target.correct_example_en: I watched a movie last night.
target.common_mistake_en: I yesterday watch a movie.
target.correction: 改为 I watched a movie last night. 过去的时间要用动词过去式 watched，时间词放句末更自然。
required_material: 动词过去式的基本概念

accepted_answers_en: I watched a movie last night.
She is doing her homework now.
I usually get up at seven.
He has already left.
She has just got home.
She just got home.
I saw him two days ago.
We will meet tomorrow.
They are watching a movie.
I didn't sleep well last night.
She usually takes the bus to work.
I am very busy now.

transfer_cases.prompt_zh: 他三天前买了一部新手机。

groups.group_title: 主谓必须一致：第三人称单数谓语加 s
groups.learning_goal: 能在一股现在时里根据主语的人称和单复数，正确给谓语加 s 或保持原形。

example_sentence.english: She likes music.
He goes to school at seven.
She has two children.
He does his homework after dinner.
My father watches TV every evening.
example_sentence.chinese: 我爸爸每天晚上看电视。

example_sentence.english: The child likes music.

target.chinese: 主谓必须一致：第三人称单数谓语加 s
target.rule: 一般现在时里，主语是第三人称单数（he、she、it、单个人或物）时，谓语动词要加 s 或 es；其他人称用动词原形。
target.when_to_use: 描述习惯、事实和日常状态时。
target.structure: 第三人称单数主语 + 动词-s / es
target.correct_example_en: She likes music.
target.common_mistake_en: She like music.
target.correction: 改为 She likes music. 主语 she 是第三人称单数，like 要加 s。
required_material: 人称与单复数的基本概念

accepted_answers_en: He likes music.

groups.group_title: 修饰语后置：用 who/which/that 把修饰挂到名词后面
groups.learning_goal: 能先说出名词，再用 who、which、that 引导的句子修饰它，说出简单的定语从句。

common_collocations.english: the man who is standing there

target.chinese: 修饰语后置：先说名词，再用 who/which/that 挂修饰
target.rule: 中文说“穿红衣服的女孩”，修饰语放在名词前；英文先说出名词，再用 who（指人）、which（指物）、that（人或物）引导一个句子挂在后面。
target.when_to_use: 需要说明是“哪一个”或“什么样的”人或物时。
target.structure: 名词 + who/which/that + 句子
target.correct_example_en: The man who is standing at the door is my teacher.
target.common_mistake_en: The man is standing at the door is my teacher.
target.correction: 改为 The man who is standing at the door is my teacher. 两个句子之间要加 who 把修饰部分连接起来。

groups.group_title: 情态动词是特权阶级：后面一律跟动词原形
groups.learning_goal: 能在 can、could、must、should、may 后面使用动词原形，不误加 s、ed 或 ing。

example_sentence.english: I can swim.
Could you help me?
You must go now.
You should go to bed early.
May I come in?
Can you help me?
She can swim very well.
He can speak English.

target.english: Modal Verbs Take the Base Form
target.chinese: 情态动词后面一律跟动词原形
target.rule: can、could、must、should、may 后面一律接动词原形，不加 s、ed 或 ing。这条规则没有例外。
target.when_to_use: 表达能力、义务、建议、许可时。
target.structure: 情态动词 + 动词原形
target.correct_example_en: She can speak English.
target.common_mistake_en: She can speaks English.
target.correction: 改为 She can speak English. can 后面必须用动词原形 speak。

accepted_answers_en: I can swim.
You should go to bed early.
Can you help me?
He must go now.
May I come in?
She can speak English.

groups.group_title: 逻辑连接词不可少：因果转折并列选择要说清楚
groups.learning_goal: 能用 because、so、but、although、and、or 明确表达因果、转折、并列和选择关系。

example_sentence.english: We stayed at home because it rained.
example_sentence.chinese: 因为下雨，我们待在家里。

example_sentence.english: It was late, so we went home.
example_sentence.chinese: 天很晚了，所以我们回家了。

example_sentence.english: He is young but very busy.
Although he was tired, he went to work.
example_sentence.chinese: 虽然他很累，但他还是去上班了。

example_sentence.english: I like tea and coffee.
Do you want tea or coffee?

target.chinese: 逻辑连接词不可少
target.rule: 中文的因果关系有时靠语序和语境体会，英文要用连接词把关系说明白：because 表原因，so 表结果，but 表转折，although 表让步，and 表并列，or 表选择。
target.when_to_use: 把两个意思连成一句话或一段话时。
target.structure: 句子 + because/so/but/although/and/or + 句子
target.correct_example_en: It was late, so we went home.
target.common_mistake_en: It was late, we went home.
target.correction: 改为 It was late, so we went home. 两个句子之间的逻辑关系要用连接词标明。

groups.group_title: want / need / decide to do：想做、需要做、决定做
groups.learning_goal: 能用 want to do、need to do、decide to do 说出想要、需要和决定做的事情。

example_sentence.english: I want to buy two tickets.

I want to buy two tickets.
You need to rest.
We decided to have a meeting next week.

target.chinese: want、need、decide 后面接动作要用 to do
target.rule: want、need、decide 后面再接另一个动作时，要用 to do，不能直接接动词原形。
target.when_to_use: 表达想要、需要、决定做某事时。
target.structure: want / need / decide + to + 动词原形
target.correct_example_en: I want to buy two tickets.
target.common_mistake_en: I want buy two tickets.
target.correction: 改为 I want to buy two tickets. want 后面接动作要用 to do。

accepted_answers_en: I want to buy two tickets.

groups.group_title: finish / enjoy / mind doing：后面只能加 -ing
groups.learning_goal: 能用 finish doing、enjoy doing、mind doing 表达完成、喜欢和介意做某事，不误用 to do。

word_root.formation_note: 来自拉丁语 finire，词根 fin- 表示结束、界限。

example_sentence.english: I finished reading this book.

word_root.formation_note: 由 en-（使……）加 joy（快乐）构成，表示使快乐、享受。

example_sentence.english: She enjoys cooking.
Do you mind opening the window?
I finished reading this book.
She enjoys cooking.
Do you mind opening the window?

target.chinese: finish、enjoy、mind 后面只能接 doing
target.rule: finish、enjoy、mind 后面接动作时只能用 doing，不能接 to do。这是固定用法，需要整体记住。
